summary: The two remaining screens come from the missing music.c:charm_snakes() call after a successful wooden-flute gate. Its visible snake reaction is the next message after the flute line; topl.c:update_topl() therefore inserts the step-78 --More-- prompt before replacing that line. JS still records note_unported("music.c charm_snakes") and skips both the snake state changes and message. Port and wire the whole charm_snakes helper in js/music.js; the existing pager implementation is not the source defect.

source.branch: In do_improvisation(WOODEN_FLUTE), when the hero is not stunned or confused and rn2(ACURR(A_DEX)) + u.ulevel > 25, C calls charm_snakes(u.ulevel * 3). charm_snakes traverses fmon and affects each living S_SNAKE that can move and has mdistu(mon) strictly less than that distance. It saves prior visibility and peacefulness, sets peaceful, clears mavenge and STRAT_WAITMASK, clears mundetected, redraws with newsym, then emits a message only if the snake is visible after the redraw: “You notice ... swaying with the music” when it was not visible before, otherwise “... freezes, then sways with the music” with “, and now seems quieter” only when previously hostile. The helper does not tame snakes or draw RNG. The recorded level-20 flute passes with rn2(15)=14; the adjacent visible hostile moving snake is inside distance 60.
callers: C: apply.c:doapply() dispatches WOODEN_FLUTE to music.c:do_play_instrument(obj); js/apply.js:doapply() has the same instrument dispatch to js/music.js:do_play_instrument().
C: music.c:do_play_instrument() accepts the recorded “y” for Improvise? and calls do_improvisation(); js/music.js:do_play_instrument() sends the yes/default branch to do_improvisation().

C: music.c:do_improvisation() completes its flute message and Hero_playnotes() call, then calls charm_snakes(u.ulevel * 3) when do_spec is true; js/music.js:do_improvisation() currently replaces this call with note_unported("music.c charm_snakes") and proceeds to exercise().

C message path: charm_snakes() emits its visible-monster pline after the flute messages; win/tty/topl.c:update_topl()/more() provides the pager boundary before replacing the full top line. JS already has the matching ttyPline/dismissPendingTtyMessage path in js/tty_message.js.
dependencies: hack.h:mdistu(mon) expands to distu()/hacklib.c:dist2(); the strict squared-Euclidean range predicate is implemented by js/hacklib.js:dist2().
display.c:canseemon() supplies the before/after visibility predicates consumed by the message branches; js/vision.js:canseemon() is already present.
display.c:newsym() is a side-effect-only redraw after mundetected is cleared; js/display.js:newsym() is already present.
do_name.c:a_monnam() and Monnam() provide the two message names; js/do_name.js already implements both.

pline.c You()/pline() route through win/tty/topl.c update_topl()/more(); js/tty_message.js already models the pager. Hero_playnotes() is an empty macro in this recorder build (include/sndprocs.h:272-273), so no sound call or RNG should be invented.

Here the snake reaction is the third message, so the prompt visible at step 78 is raised by charm_snakes()’s pline before its text replaces the flute line. space at step 79 resumes the same ordered path. This explains both remaining screens without changing the correct existing pager port.
